title: U.S. Life Saving Station 30

services.name: The Surfboat
services.desc: In order for the men of The Life Saving Service to protect lives and cargo; a wide range of skills, technology and equipment was always at the ready. On the front line of these efforts was the surfboat. Every station had at least one and they varied in design in different regions of the country.
